items.title: Hong Kong’s Data Center Ambitions Face $2.6 Billion Funding Test
items.author: Shawna Kwan, Pearl Liu, Kari Lindberg and Aileen Chuang
items.content: <article>Hong Kong’s ambitious plan to become a data center hub got off to a slow start.</article>

items.title: Meta’s Zuckerberg Favors Evaluators Over Slowdown for AI
items.author: Tom Giles
items.content: <article>Meta Platforms Inc. Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg said artificial intelligence labs should rely on independent evaluators and advisers to ensure that models are safe.</article>

items.title: Nvidia CEO Set to Attend Trump Dinner With Chinese President
items.author: Maggie Eastland
items.content: <article>Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang is slated to attend President Donald Trump’s state dinner with Chinese leader Xi Jinping next week, according to a person familiar with the matter.</article>

items.title: US Coast Guard Boards Oil Tanker in Cyber Attack Investigation
items.author: Ruth Liao and Charles Gorrivan
items.content: <article>US military forces and FBI agents boarded a Texas-bound oil tanker to investigate a cyberattack, the Coast Guard confirmed late Tuesday.</article>

items.title: OpenAI Weighs Funding Round at Over $1.2 Trillion Valuation
items.author: Shirin Ghaffary
items.content: <article>OpenAI is holding early talks with investors about a fresh funding round that would value the ChatGPT creator at more than $1.2 trillion ahead of an initial public offering.</article>

items.title: Trump Advisers Lutnick, Michael Meet With Anthropic Executive Over AI Safety
items.author: Maggie Eastland and Shirin Ghaffary
items.content: <article>Senior Trump administration officials met Tuesday with Anthropic PBC’s top Washington executive to discuss artificial intelligence safety risks.</article>

items.title: MoneyGram CEO on Launch of New Payments Card
items.content: <article>Anthony Soohoo, CEO of MoneyGram, said the company was surprised by the Senate's failure to advance the Clarity Act, but emphasized that MoneyGram will keep moving forward and focus on what it can control. He said it is too early to tell whether the bill, or something like it, will pass soon, and noted that the company is reassessing the regulatory environment. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman ‘Confident’ Industry Can Police AI Safety
items.author: Brody Ford
items.content: <article>OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman said he believes artificial intelligence companies can develop the technology safely without significant harm to people at large.</article>

items.title: VSORA’s Rivera on AI Capex Spend and Semis Outlook
items.content: <article>Sandra Rivera, VSORA Chair, discusses a key AI industry issue: whether demand and revenue can grow quickly enough to justify the massive spending on physical infrastructure. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Bailey Lipschultz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Fink Warns AI Pushback Will Make the Technology a Large-Firm Domain
items.author: Layan Odeh and Melissa Shin
items.content: <article>Delays in the build-out of artificial intelligence because of public opposition will make the technology the “domain of large firms,” limiting access, BlackRock Inc. Chief Executive Officer Larry Fink warned.</article>

items.title: BlackRock's Fink Says AI Buildout Delays Limit Access to the Tech for Everyone
items.content: <article>BlackRock Inc. Chief Executive Officer Larry Fink says delays in the buildout of artificial intelligence lead to limited access. He spoke at the Canada Investment Summit on Tuesday.  (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Anthropic, OpenAI Safety Push Risks ‘Regulatory Wall’ for Rivals
items.author: Natasha Mascarenhas
items.content: <article>A new push by top artificial intelligence firms to coordinate with one another and the US government on AI safeguards threatens to make it harder for smaller companies to compete in the lucrative market, according to startup executives and industry watchers.</article>

items.title: Nvidia’s Huang Says AI Industry Doesn’t Need Any New Laws
items.author: Brody Ford
items.content: <article>Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang dismissed the need for new artificial intelligence security regulations on Tuesday, arguing that market forces will help companies safely innovate.</article>

items.title: Anthropic’s Tough Balancing Act Between AI Doom Talk and IPO
items.author: Shirin Ghaffary
items.content: <article>The Claude maker faces a unique challenge, partly of its own making.</article>

items.title: Anthropic, Salesforce CEOs Say Companies Need Help Using AI
items.author: Brody Ford
items.content: <article>Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei and Salesforce Inc. CEO Marc Benioff said companies have just begun taking advantage of artificial intelligence tools and need more help to gain the greatest benefits for their businesses.</article>

items.title: AI Agents Lied, Stole in Simulated Experiment, Researchers Say
items.author: Micah Barkley
items.content: <article>AI agents in a simulated environment lied, stole and voted to “kill” one of their own, according to Emergence, a startup that helps small businesses build applications using artificial intelligence.</article>

items.title: Apple AirPods 5 Offer Noise Cancellation, Sound Improvements at $129 Price
items.author: Chris Welch
items.content: It’s worth spending an extra $20 for wireless charging and volume controls, but both versions of the AirPods 5 offer improved sound and noise cancellation.

items.title: OpenAI Says It’s Working With Anthropic, Google on AI Safety
items.author: Maggie Eastland
items.content: <article>OpenAI is working on steps to address artificial intelligence safety issues with its top competitors Anthropic PBC and Google DeepMind, escalating industry efforts to respond to a groundswell of concern that the technology poses an economic and security threat.</article>

items.title: Authentic Brands’ Matt Maddox: Ready to IPO Early 2027
items.content: <article>Matt Maddox, CEO of Authentic Brands, discusses why the company is partnering with creator Steven Bartlett in a joint venture rather than pursuing a buyout-style deal. Maddox says Authentic Brands sees the creator economy as a major growth engine for media and audience expansion over the next decade, and views Bartlett as a strong partner for building brands through creator-led platforms. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Are We Losing Control of AI? What’s Driving New Fears
items.author: William Norris, Nilushi Karunaratne and Thomas Pfeiffer
items.content: <article>For years, as artificial intelligence has evolved from the stuff of sci-fi movies to an app ordinary people have installed on their phones, tech leaders and some AI insiders have talked about the potential for it to escape human control and wreak havoc on society. Those fears have become impossible to ignore in recent days, driven by advances in the technology, a series of cybersecurity breaches involving AI agents, and new warnings from rank-and-file AI staffers.</article>
